data_description.max_color_temp: Active when Circadian Rhythm is enabled. Applied during peak solar noon.

late_night.description: Dim nighttime preset triggered by schedule or bedtime helper.

data.late_night_entity: Late Night Active Helper Entity / Group

data_description.late_night_pct: Active when Late Night Mode is enabled. Target brightness during late night window.
data_description.late_night_condition_type: Choose between fixed clock time or an entity/group state helper.
data_description.late_night_entity: Binary sensor or boolean switch that triggers Late Night when ON.
data_description.late_night_start_entity: Optional input_datetime helper to override fixed start time.
data_description.late_night_stop_entity: Optional input_datetime helper to override fixed stop time.

media.name: 📺 Media Control
media.description: Dim room lights automatically when media players are active.

data.media_respect_ambient_lux: Respect Natural Daylight (Keep / Turn Off in Daylight)

data_description.media_entities: Select media players to watch. When playing, lights transition to media brightness.
data_description.media_seed_pct: Baseline brightness percentage applied when media is playing.
data_description.media_respect_ambient_lux: When enabled, media lighting only turns on when ambient lux is below the target threshold. If natural daylight is sufficient, lights remain off.

bypasses.name: 🛑 Bypasses & Overrides
bypasses.description: Configure physical switch overrides, freeze holds, force-off bypasses, and power grid status.

data.create_override_switch: Create Dedicated Native Manual Override Switch
data.ignore_max_brightness_override: Ignore Max Brightness Override (turning on to 100% won't lock)

data_description.bypass_freeze_entities: Entities that pause automations and hold current light level when active.
data_description.bypass_off_entities: Entities (e.g. Away Mode) that pause automations and force lights off.
data_description.override_timeout_min: Minutes to keep manual override active before resuming automatic control.
data_description.ignore_max_brightness_override: When enabled, turning lights to 100% is treated as normal on rather than a manual lockout.
data_description.settling_cooldown_sec: Time to wait for slow illuminance sensors (e.g. Aqara Matter, battery Zigbee) to report before making another closed-loop brightness adjustment.

notification_light.name: 🔔 Visual Notification Lights
notification_light.description: Configure an individual light bulb to display visual notifications (e.g. laundry alert) while other room lights operate normally.

data.notification_presence_gated: Presence-Gated (Only illuminate when room is occupied)

data_description.notification_light_enabled: When enabled, the selected light bulb will display the visual alert color when the trigger is active.
data_description.notification_trigger_entity: Entity that triggers the visual notification when ON or ACTIVE.
data_description.notification_light_entity: Specific light fixture or bulb (e.g. overhead pendant) to claim out of the room group.
data_description.notification_color: RGB color to display for the visual notification.
data_description.notification_brightness_pct: Brightness percentage for the visual notification.
data_description.notification_presence_gated: When enabled, the notification bulb turns on only when room presence is detected, and turns off when vacant.
data_description.notification_suppression_entities: Entities that suppress the notification when active (e.g. input_boolean.sleeping_in_living_room or input_select.home_state).

holiday_select.title: Select Holiday to Edit
holiday_select.description: Choose an existing holiday to edit its schedule, effects, and lights, or select 'Add New Holiday'.

holiday_edit.title: Edit Holiday Settings
holiday_edit.description: Configure dates, theme color, Hue scene, dynamic effects, and participating fixtures for this holiday.

data.name: Holiday Name
data.effect: Bulb Firmware Effect (e.g. fire, candle, prism)
data.fallback_effect: Fallback Bulb Effect (if primary effect unavailable)

holiday_reset.title: Reset Holiday Catalog
holiday_reset.description: Are you sure you want to restore the built-in holiday catalog? This will revert any custom dates, effects, or added holidays to their default settings.

start_presence_simulation.name: Start Presence Simulation
start_presence_simulation.description: Activates presence simulation across all lights tagged with the configured label (default 'lights_presence_simulation').

stop_presence_simulation.name: Stop Presence Simulation
stop_presence_simulation.description: Deactivates presence simulation. If stopping at night with Home mode active, performs graceful handover to room controllers; otherwise sweeps off all simulated lights.

apply_holiday_lighting.name: Apply Holiday Lighting
apply_holiday_lighting.description: Manually triggers or re-evaluates holiday lighting according to the active holiday schedule.

preview_holiday.name: Preview Holiday
preview_holiday.description: Previews a holiday lighting scene and effects across configured lights for a short test period.
